title: NewtekOne, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-03
summary: NewtekOne, Inc. filed a Form 8-K current report disclosing the renewal of employment agreements for four executive officers: CEO Barry Sloane, CLO Michael A. Schwartz, CFO Frank DeMaria, and Newtek Bank President Peter Downs. The renewals extend agreements for one-year terms with unchanged compensation terms, except for non-renewal payment provisions.
key_points: NewtekOne, Inc. renewed employment agreements for CEO Barry Sloane, CLO Michael A. Schwartz, and CFO Frank DeMaria for additional one-year terms.
Newtek Bank, N.A. renewed the employment agreement for President Peter Downs for an additional one-year term.
Terms and conditions of the Sloane Employment Agreement remain unchanged from the prior agreement filed with the Q1 2025 10-Q.
Downs, Schwartz, and DeMaria employment agreements each provide for a Non-renewal Payment equal to one year of base compensation.
NewtekOne trades on Nasdaq Global Market LLC under ticker NEWT with multiple debt securities listed.
The employment agreements will be filed as exhibits to the company's next Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q.
